verdict.rationale: Logseq is a knowledge-base app, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions one. The local HTTP API server (bearer-token POST /api dispatching plugin methods) is only a developer building block that someone could wrap into an MCP server; it is not the capability itself and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
